notes: Separate native-green pure public-API Annex C.5 Create Federation Execution witnesses use three schema-valid, adapter-owned FOM modules. Equal same-label synchronization declarations compose; a declaration with the same label but an added note reference is rejected as InconsistentFOM, after which a valid Create reuses the name. Each module creates alone. Installed-package CTest and direct runner passed 8/8 each across both callback models. Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR, and both focused packaged Umbra JNI runtime scenarios passed (out/java-tck/synchronization-duplicate-equal-jni-20261021.json and out/java-tck/synchronization-duplicate-note-conflict-jni-20261021.json). Public APIs do not expose the private synchronization table's row count. Other Java providers, element conflicts, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
